newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA AND HOIU PROPEL BOURSE TO NEW RECORD.
newsitem.headline: HANSA AND HOIU PROPEL BOURSE TO NEW RECORD.

text.p: * Total trade at 106.4 million kroons vs 71.4 million
kroons.
* Index 1.29 percent higher to reach a new record of 356.60.
* 25 stocks traded: 10 up, 9 down, 6 steady.
* Hansapank was the most active to turn over 41.5
million kroons to gain 0.60 kroons to 196.10 kroons.
* Hoiupank turned over 19.5 million kroons to
close 7.70 kroons higher at 221.45 kroons.
The bourse remained volatile on
Thursday as unexpected gains in Hansapank and Hoiupank took the
bourse index to a new recond high, dealers said.
Total trade on the main list was 106.4 million kroons with
the Talse 1.29 percent higher to close at a record level of
"The market was very volatile today, with the number of
buying orders completely unexpected this morning," dealers
said.
"It is hard to say where the bourse will go tomorrow--it
remains unpredictable," he added.
Hansapank lead the bourse with 41.5 million kroons traded
to close 0.60 kroons higher on 196.10 kroons.
"The significant thing is that Hansapank reached 200 kroons
today, which is an important barrier for the stock," one trader
said.
However, dealers said that resistance at the 200 kroon
level is strong and the stock is not expected to go beyond that
level at this time.
In Helsinki, Hansapank was traded up to 74.50
markka to close at 74 markka, one markka higher.
Buying interest in Hoiupank was strong throughout the day
and dealers said that the soon to be released bank's revised
profit estimate could help fuel further increases.
Hoiupank was up 7.70 kroons to close at 221.45 kroons after
turning over 19.5 million kroons.
On the free market, 21.9 million kroons changed hands with
privatisation securities the most active stock.
The securities saw trade of 12.8 million kroons to close at
0.395 down from 0.43 kroons.
